title: NES controller-port bridge, v1b
intro: The bench drives an unmodified NES-001 through its controller port and records what the console does about it. This package is the v1b build: an Arduino UNO between a Raspberry Pi and the console, everything on one 5 V rail, the UNO's; the console shares only ground.

Nothing here is placed or typed by hand. The schematic's arrangement is authored and its coordinates come from the parts' own sizes; the parts list, the wiring list, the pin map and the chip sheets are read back out of that file, the lab log and the bring-up tool. A sheet whose smallest text would print below 5 pt is refused rather than shrunk, which is why two sheets are ANSI B.
AUTHORED means not yet measured. MEASURED carries its date and its record in docs/lab-notebook.md.
